children: Embrace Change Acquisition received a termination notice from Tianji Tire Global on Sep 10, 2026, ending their Merger Agreement. The agreement, originally signed on Jan 26, 2025 and amended on Oct 16, 2025, was terminated under the provision allowing either party to walk away after the Aug 12, 2026 outside date if the merger had not closed. The termination appears to be an expiry due to timing, with no fees disclosed. The company did not indicate any immediate alternative transaction.
: Merger not completed by Aug 12 2026 outside date
